pages.text: $(l)Getting fireclay balls$()$(li)Mine a fireclay block with a shovel: it drops $(item)1 fireclay ball$().$(li)Four balls craft back into a fireclay block for storage.

$(l)Firing the bricks$()$(br)Smelt a $(item)fireclay ball$() in a furnace (10 seconds) to get one $(item)fireproof brick$(). Four fireproof bricks in a 2 by 2 grid craft one block of $(item)fireproof bricks$().$(br2)Single bricks and brick blocks are both used:

$(li)$(item)Fireproof brick$() (item): the casting basin.$(li)$(item)Fireproof bricks$() (block): the blast stove, the blast furnace output and hatch, and the walls of the blast furnace itself.$(li)Six blocks give six $(item)fireproof brick reinforcement$() walls.
A blast furnace eats many brick blocks, so set up an automatic fireclay line early.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
